findings.text: Leak detection re-observes real surface liveness rather than trusting bookkeeping; the live container path is unexercised in the home gate by design (reference), proven only via the injected fake runtime.

summary: X6 (WARP-0406, ephemeral environment provisioning) is correct and honest. Independent adversarial review: pass_with_notes, gate GREEN, the lifecycle driven independently against both backends (fake: clean-on-create, seed observable, observe-after-teardown raises EnvStateError, idempotent double teardown, leak detection; live: fails loud without a runtime). Non-tautology 9/9 (skip-seed, skip-teardown, always-live, always-fixtures-present and more all caught). Reference status honest (no container surface in the home gate; live path fails loud); proportionate (stdlib seam, no bespoke provisioning stack); both capabilities.yaml copies byte-identical; generic; ASCII. proof_digest recomputed via validate.py.
